outcome: New-onset or exacerbation of heart failure
cohort: 50 pregnant women (30 with pulmonary artery hypertension and 20 with Eisenmenger syndrome) at a large tertiary care university hospital.
finding: While maternal mortality was not significantly different between groups, fetomaternal outcomes, including new-onset or exacerbation of heart failure and hypoxaemia, were significantly worse in pregnant women with Eisenmenger syndrome compared to those with PAH.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome measure, but no specific finding reported.
